environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (Elastic Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443. The ELB performs SSL termination but does not inspect HTTP content. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application container runs with NET_RAW capability and the SQLite database is on a local EBS volume. No request filtering or inspection layer exists between the client and the Flask application.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB, TCP mode, SSL termination only
